_siteUrl: The public address of the site, with a trailing slash. Used for the canonical link and link previews (they need absolute URLs).
_og: Link-preview image (scripts/og.mjs): the TMDb ids of the 15 cases facing out, row by row (5 per shelf). Too few: other faves fill in.

og._posters: Posters to use on the card instead of the site's, by TMDb id and language (file paths from TMDb's images): for films whose usual poster is covered in text.

_skipMarkers: Copies whose '❓' cell contains one of these are left out: ⏳ ordered / not received yet, ❌ duplicate to sell, 🫥 never received.
_picks: Tom's picks from the 'note T' column (out of 5): faves from faveMin, recommendations from recommendedMin. Unrated films go in data/picks.json.
_posters: 'original': poster in the original language when it is English or French, otherwise the international one.
